title: DSA in TypeScript
description: Classic data structures and algorithms implemented in TypeScript, from arrays and hashing through trees and dynamic programming.
longDescription:
## Data Structures & Algorithms in TypeScript

The same DSA curriculum as the Python track, but implemented in TypeScript. Practice the patterns in a statically typed environment.

### Topics covered

- Arrays, hashing, and sliding window techniques
- Two-pointer and string manipulation patterns
- Linked list traversal, reversal, and cycle detection
- Binary trees: traversal, depth, paths, and construction
- Binary search, dynamic programming, and bit manipulation
